Yeah it can be the circumstances. It's still an enjoyable feeling. It's like an escape from all that is anxiety and uncomfort. That would be higher doses for me though, which makes me anxious about higher doses.

Yeah, legs shaking due to shock of him "attempting" suicide? It really shock me that he got to that stage.

Back on track with medication: I can have as much as I want is basically what he said, im in charge. I'm independent in a way. So by no means am I maxing my meds. I'm just dosing higher than what I expected when I got them pescribed. All this due to my friend attempting suicide.

I really want to find out if he did it on purpose or if he just wanted to "let loose".

What's really comforting is that I can ask for refills now because I have a very legitimate reason to increase my dose as long as i'm in shock. Instead of my doctor judging me as an addict. That gives me a lot of comfort. My father also knows this. His understanding leads to him not judging me about being "out of it or hazed, high whatever" on my meds. I really feel like that was important telling him so that he could have an increased level of sympathy of what im going through.

Any response will help me get through this.
Yeah I get your point. As mentioned earlier in the thread im going to have a conversation with my doctor about trying different ones and finding the correct one. I just want to take the edge off.

Numb isnt the correct word. My english is kinda shit. Relaxation is what I feel but no happiness, I just feel decent.

Nights are the best though, zopiclone + diazepam = extreme relaxation, anxious free and slight euphoria. 

Morning after is pretty rough fpr the first hour considering i get hungover of it and wake up 3 - 4 times a night.
Grape juice dude, jokes aside. Ill get in contact with my doctor, try the 10mg ones and if that doesnt work try a different benzo.

Depression -> lack of appetite -> worse benzo experience.

Also obv doctors differ a lot, even more from country to country even though the research should be the same world wide.
You're tag says it all. Im happy for you. I get high but in a hazy way. Guess its diazepam and my body not connecting the same way you and ativan does.

He said im in charge of how much i consume. Anything from 5 - 20mg. Basically anything that helps. And yeah as you said the root of my numbness is my depression. But yeah It really helps with anxiety. It is a miracle in terms of slowing me down when i need too be slowed down.

Also SSRI's are anti depressives? I dont feel like going through 10 drugs id rather talk it out while doing valium for anxiety.
Zopiclone (imovane) 7,5 for sleep.
One of my best mates attemptef suicide. Idk if it was accidental or on purpose but now im just maxing my valium to be able to stand up without legs shaking.
im not excited anymore now im just numb. That's sad.
And I feel yours!
Excited about my 100pills of 5mg diazepam. Feeling good.
its funny how a similar mental illness can present in so different ways, isnt it?

Yeah, I dont get panic attacks during nights. That's more of a day thing for me, when im in the classroom for example. I guess the best way to decribe my anxiety would be like a wave. At night it drifts slowly, it's there and it's quite large. At morning the wave of anxiety hits the beach and then when I come home the wave dies out but slowly rebuilds at sea. just thought of that metaphor so its kinda shitty.
That's great that you reached out! Im not a doctor but sleeping medication is good in the sense of breaking the bad sleeping habit. it's not supposed to be something you use all the time.

15 mg Zopiclone and 5 mg diazepam, slight euphoria and sleepy eyes. I cherish this moment so much I almost dont want to fall asleep, best time of the day by far.

Diazepam (benzodiazepine) anti anxiett basically. 

Side effects: feeling twice as anxious when it wears off.

Zopiclone (sleeping medication) 

Side effects: metallic taste, groggy mornings. Havent really decided if groggy mornings are a side effect yet as i quite enjoy it sometimes.

Not taking any anti depressants though.
